# Traffic Monitor

> Open-source roadway counting and speed monitoring on a Raspberry Pi

These docs are versioned. For AI tools, use the latest release:

- [llms.txt for the latest release](https://docs.trafficmonitor.ai/latest/llms.txt): an index of every page, each as Markdown
- [llms-full.txt for the latest release](https://docs.trafficmonitor.ai/latest/llms-full.txt): every page in one file

Each version has its own copies, for example https://docs.trafficmonitor.ai/dev/llms.txt for unreleased changes.
